seoTitle: About Chardeevari (चारदीवारी) – Building Material Delivery, Ranchi
seoDescription: Chardeevari connects home builders in Ranchi with trusted local building-material stores. 60-min delivery near Kadru, Harmu, Ashok Nagar, Doranda. Cash on delivery.
intro: Chardeevari (चारदीवारी, also written Char Deevari) is a Ranchi platform that connects people building a home with trusted local building-material stores. You order cement, sariya (TMT), balu, cement eent or gitti on this website, on WhatsApp or in our Android app, and a partner store near your site delivers it — usually in about 60 minutes. You pay cash on delivery.
name: The name चारदीवारी means “four walls” — what every home starts with.

how.title: How it works
steps: Check today's rate for each material on the website or in the app.
Order online, in the app or on WhatsApp (+91 92415 14013).
A partner store near your site loads the material and delivers it, usually in about 60 minutes.
Pay cash when the material reaches your site.

area.title: Where we deliver
area.text: Within about 5 km of Kadru, Harmu, Ashok Nagar and Doranda in Ranchi. We do not deliver outside these areas yet.

materials.title: What we deliver
materials.text: ACC, Dalmia and Concreto cement; Rungta TMT sariya; river sand (balu); grey cement bricks; stone chips (gitti); and cover blocks. See today's rate for each:

team.title: Who runs Chardeevari
team.text: Chardeevari was founded by Ayush Akash in Ranchi and works from 217, Kadru, AG Colony.

contact.title: Contact and hours
contact.hoursValue: Monday to Saturday, 9 AM – 6 PM (Sunday closed)
